name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; python3 -m pip install --user uv && python3 -m uv sync; echo '✅ Packages installed and Requirements met'

postAttachCommand.server: python3 -m uv run streamlit run app.py --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
